title: 3 Common Windshield Defroster Mistakes Everyone Makes
hook: Stop using your defroster the wrong way.

script.narration: Stop using your defroster the wrong way.

script.narration: First, never blast maximum heat on freezing glass instantly. Second, always turn off internal air circulation to pull in dry outside air. Third, do not wipe the inside glass with a dirty cloth.
Use moderate air and clear moisture instantly. Like if this helped, follow for daily driving tips. Did you know this? Comment yes or no, because
